name: Seer
body:
You have learned to examine things with a slightly magical eye.

Benefit(s): You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day plus one additional time for every 4 character levels you possess: detect magic, detect secret doors, and read magic. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level.
